name: Pi Security
description: Integrate Pi Security with Claude to give your workflows superpowers and unlock new ones using our industry-leading context engine.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pi Security to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pi Security to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pi.security/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pi Security MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pi Security lists 21 MCP tools, including pi_design_review_get, pi_design_review_markdown_create, pi_design_review_url_create, pi_design_reviews_list, pi_finding_get, pi_findings_list, pi_gatekeeper_issue_get, pi_gatekeeper_issues_list, pi_gatekeeper_pr_get, pi_gatekeeper_prs_list, pi_knowledgebase_query, and pi_package_remediation_plan_fetch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pi Security?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pi Security in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Pi Security MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pi Security requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pi Security is developed by Pi Security. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
